name: Greenheck QEID Upblast roof fan
summary: Direct-drive roof exhaust fan in the QEID upblast configuration.
description: Coordinate the fan support and vertical discharge with the roof services layout. Include access to the motor, terminals and the discharge assembly.
The downloadable GA illustration is independently authored conceptual geometry, with no scale or manufacturer dimensions. Use the official CAD source for the exact layout.
readingNotes: Use the dedicated QEID Upblast files rather than the QEID inline model or the belt-driven QEI Upblast model.
QEID and QEI identify different drive arrangements; physical envelopes and service tasks must be checked separately.
drawingChecklist: Reserve motor access and an unobstructed discharge path.
